<b>Couriers Tipp & Pill</b> are [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchants]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are brothers that offer [[Delivery Wishes|deliveries]] in [[Bellhart]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]]. Tipp is the round one and Pill is the tall one.

== Background ==
Tipp & Pill are two brothers who work as couriers for the citizens of Pharloom.<ref>Tipp: <i>"Miss courier! Pharloom's bugs are wishing, waiting, sad and scared. The deliverings are needed, now more than more!"</i></ref> Tipp works as [[Frey]]'s supplier,<ref>[[Frey]]: <i>"Oh yes, even my supplier is back to work, so I have plenty of goods to show you!"</i></ref> and is the first brother that Hornet rescues. Pill is implied to be an older brother, as he refers to Tipp as "Young Tipp" in one of his dialogues.<ref>Pill: <i>"Young Tipp! How he worries always. Blessed I am for the care, him and you Miss Hornet! A lucky bug is me!"</i></ref> After being rescued, they reside at [[Bellhart]].

== In-game Events ==
After completing the Main Objective [[SAVE: The Threadspun Town]], the [[My Missing Courier]] wish becomes available. After promising the wish, Tipp can be found in the area above [[Bone Bottom]]. After he returns to [[Bellhart]], [[Frey]] has additional goods for sale.

After completing the wish [[My Missing Courier]], accepting the wish [[Great Taste of Pharloom]], and talking to the [[Caretaker]] of [[Songclave]], the wish [[My Missing Brother]] becomes available. After promising the wish, Pill can be found in [[Sinner's Road]]. After he returns to Bellhart, Tipp & Pill offer [[Delivery Wishes]]. They also offer the [[Courier's Rasher]] for the completion of the [[Great Taste of Pharloom]] quest.

Delivery Wishes involve accepting a delivery from Tipp & Pill to another [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] somewhere else in Pharloom. Deliveries are fragile and take damage when Hornet does. Making a heavy landing, hitting a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], and running into a wall while using [[Swift Step]] also damages the item. If the item takes too much damage (denoted below Hornet's health bar), it breaks and another one must be acquired from Tipp & Pill to re-attempt the delivery. Using [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], travelling with the [[Flea Caravan]], or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys the item.

== Wishes ==
Deliveries of any "Supplies" can be repeated an infinite amount of times, allowing for a steady source of [[Rosaries]]. However, Tipp & Pill will only offer 2 Deliveries at a time. The most recently completed Delivery will never appear twice in a row. In addition, only the first completion of a Delivery contributes towards <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i>.

{{TabbedDialogue
| Title1 = Tipp, Shellwood
| Title1_Event1 = First encounter
| Title1_Dialogue1 = Oh! Those horrible beasty-beasts are gone! Much and many thanks for you, mighty warrior!<br>
{{HTalk| It was a simple thing, small bug. I assume you are Tipp, the courier?}}<br>
{{HTalk| Frey, the Bellhart trader, seemed concerned for your safety... and for the cargo you carry.}}<br>
She sent you?! Bah! She needs to learny-learn a little patience! I'm is barely been away! But still... is lucky-lucky for me you came.
| Title1_Event2 = Speaking again
| Title1_Dialogue2 = Well, I'm is be off now. That old grubly-grub in the bell will come after me herself if she not get her goods!

| Title2 = Tipp, Bellhart
| Title2_Event1 = First encounter
| Title2_Dialogue1 = Miss saving! Thanks again for you and your big-big blade! I'm is made it back, and grumpy grub-grub got her goods. She seemed happy, even!<br>
I'm won't be travelling out for a while-while methinks. Too many beasties! All about theys are. Even those pilgrims! All now going angry, a bit like old grub-grub.<br>
{{HTalk| This town remains safe for the moment, Tipp. You're a smart bug to stay within its walls.}}
| Title2_Event2 = Speaking again
| Title2_Dialogue2 = This town feel safe, just, but I'm is worries for others. Is Pharloom needing its good-goods?<br>
Many bugs helped by us couriers, me and brother Pill. Special now when danger grows big-big.
| Title2_Event3 = Exhausted dialogue when [[Great Taste of Pharloom]] is active
| Title2_Dialogue3 = {{HTalk| Tipp, I have promised a wish to an old bug of the Citadel, ingredients for a dish to stir a gourmand's stomach.}}<br>
{{HTalk| Do you hold in your belongings a Courier's Rasher? It seems a key element.}}<br>
Courier's Rasher! Not me, miss savings! Smelly, fatty foods, good for most. Not good for my sensitive stomach!<br>
You want-want my brother, Pill! Pill is big. Pill loves rashers! Can prepare them fresh for you, but first, Pill must be found, saved, safe-safe!
| Title2_Event4 = When [[My Missing Brother]] is available
| Title2_Dialogue4 = My brother, Pill, still out there. Help-help others he must be, taking good-goods all across. I'm is only hope he stay safe-safe, but gone long is Pill. Too long!<br>
On the wishwall, I'm placed my wish-wish, that my brother returns to me, and these bells of safety's safe.<br>
{{HTalk| I shall check the wall, Tipp. If your wish aligns with my journey, I may track him down.}}
| Title2_Event5 = Exhausted dialogue when [[My Missing Brother]] is active
| Title2_Dialogue5 = {{HTalk| I have taken your wish, Tipp. If I find your brother safe, I'll be sure to send him back this way.}}<br>

| Title3_Event1 = First encounter

{{HTalk| I am Hornet, Pill. Your brother wished for your return to Bellhart, where he waits now. I'm sure he will be eager to see you alive.}}<br>
Young Tipp! How he worries always. Blessed I am for the care, him and you Miss Hornet! A lucky bug is me!<br>

Aye! Yes! To Bellhart, and my brother, I shall fly quickly-quick. If you pass that way again, stop and give greeting!

| Title4 = Tipp & Pill, Bellhart
| Title4_Event1 = First encounter

{{HTalk| I am pleased you have found one another. If you are planning to venture out again, I would urge you reconsider for the sake of your shells.}}<br>
<b>Tipp:</b> We know it! Muchly-much! We cannot be leaving this home of bells. No more! Heres we will remain, for shells to survive. <br>
<b>Pill:</b> But we instead did plan, together, clever! Yes-yes. Those pilgrims, them that pass, maybes they will help? For small reward as we have?<br>
<b>Pill:</b> Even you, miss saving! Yes-yes! Saving is done. Our wishes now we ask. Now is time for miss courier!<br>

<b>Tipp:</b> Carry the deliverings safe-safe, miss courier! Cared for like your own shell.

<b>On subsequent deliveries:</b><br>
{{HTalk| For the moment, I can not aid you, couriers. My own tasks are too pressing.}}<br>

<b>Pill:</b> Do not wait, miss courier! You hold the deliverings, so nows you must away! A quick-quick bug, you must become yourself.

<hr/>
<b>On subsequent deliveries:</b><br>

<hr/>
<b>On subsequent deliveries:</b><br>
<b>Pill:</b> Goods for the camp at base, where pilgrims' journey starts. We muchly hope this delivering goes well!

<hr/>

<b>Pill:</b> Supplies for the rest-stop in the fields. We is used to like this delivering, when we was young and muchly brave.

<b>Pill:</b> That Citadel. We knows its truths! Not so nicely-nice as pilgrims tells! Even if brave bugs would settle, danger still is close!<br>
<b>Tipp:</b> They would need deliverings, for food, for healings, for protection. Please takes them, miss courier!
<hr/>
<b>On subsequent deliveries:</b><br>
<b>Pill:</b> Good-goods for the pilgrims up high! Thems brave ones, settled up on that big-big Citadel.<br>
<b>Tipp:</b> These deliverings they will muchly need, miss courier. Carry them safe-safe, for us!
| Title4_Event10 = Accepting delivery to [[Fleatopia]]

<b>Pill:</b> Clever grubbers, fleas, but theys too need-need our deliverings. See them served, miss courier! Always goodly-good to gain the thanks of fleas.
<hr/>
<b>On subsequent deliveries:</b><br>
<b>Pill:</b> Those good-goods, all packed fresh for the clever fleas. Take thems up for us, miss courier. Maybe new friends you might be making with your service? Yes-yes?

| Title4_Dialogue11 = <b>The first time:</b><br>
<b>Tipp:</b> We is got requested times a'many for this, a queeny egg of those eaters of Silk. Wish from big, sticky creature, near many roaches caged. Wants it muchly!<br>
{{HTalk| The creature, I have met them, a timid, fawning sort. Nonetheless, their tending of Silkeaters can be a benefit for me.}}<br>
{{HTalk| If a queen delivered could improve their harvest, I too would gain from the trade.}}<br>
<b>Tipp:</b> Miss courier, and big, sticky creature? Both are like to liking things so grossly-gross? We think yous are muchly strange...
<hr/>
<b>On retries:</b><br>
<b>Tipp:</b> Another egg. Another grossy eater queen. Delivery for the big-big creature beyond the roaches. Maybe this one travels safer than last?
| Title4_Event12 = Accepting [[Liquid Lacquer]]
| Title4_Dialogue12 = <b>The first time:</b><br>
<b>Tipp:</b> A delivery deadly, dangerous, fiercably cold, for old bug up there that does need it much-much! Serves us all he does, so we serve back.<br>
<b>Pill:</b> And great test for you, miss courier! Most challenging-challenge this. The lacquer to bring is sloshy-slosh. A hard carry even for the best.<br>
{{HTalk| I have met this maker. His is a long service, worthy of respect. I will be glad to aid his efforts.}}
<hr/>
<b>On retries:</b><br>
<b>Pill:</b> More for you, miss courier! Lacquer, filled fresh, for the maker on the mount. We have much, so don't worry for our supply. <br>
<b>Pill:</b> To climb the frozen peak, it is a journey most difficult! Our thanks go full with you that tries again!
| Title4_Event13 = Speaking when [[Great Taste of Pharloom]] quest is active

<b>Pill:</b> Miss courier must know! Our rasher is delicious, strong, fatty food, but is not long to last. If not stored quick, it-it is flavour fast turns foul.<br>
{{HTalk|If the rasher is likely to spoil, then I shall make fast for the Citadel. I've no desire to see your efforts, or your scant supplies wasted.}}
<hr/>
<b>On retries:</b><br>
<b>Pill:</b> More meats for you, miss courier! Best you be delivering it swiftly quick! If left not stored, our rasher's flavour fast turns foul.
| Title4_Event15 = While [[Cursed Crest|Cursed]]

{{HTalk| A parasite has lodged deep inside my shell. It has taken some strength of will to keep its thrashing at bay.}} <br>
<b>Pill:</b> With a shell like such, you cannot be taking no deliverings! Infect the goods you would-would!<br>
{{HTalk| Very well, couriers. If I somehow manage to remove the parasite, I may return to offer aid.}}
| Title4_Event16 = Speaking again while cursed
| Title4_Dialogue16 = <b>Pill:</b> With your shell all a'wriggle, you can't be taking no deliverings! Infect the goods you would!<br>
{{HTalk|Very well, couriers. If I somehow manage to remove the parasite, I may return to offer aid.}}

Carefully, careful now!<br>
Not too slowly, now!<br>
Not too hasty, now!

==Locations==
After promising the [[wish]] <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i>, Tipp can be found in northern [[Bone Bottom]] surrounded by [[Caranid]]s. After saving him, Tipp can be found alone in Bellhart. After promising the wish <i>[[My Missing Brother]]</i>, Pill can be found in central [[Sinner's Road]]. After saving him, he can be found reunited with his brother back in Bellhart.

==Trivia==
*The sign for Tipp & Pill's courier service (placed near them after rescuing both) is made from half of the sign for [[Frey]]'s shop.
*Tipp & Pill can be hit with the [[Needle]], hitting them while they're asleep will wake them up.
*Early in development, Tipp was planned to appear in the later-cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Red Coral Gorge|Red Coral Gorge]] area.
{{History
|game = SS
|1.0.28497 (Patch 1): Fixed courier deliveries sometimes being inaccessible in the late game.
|1.0.29242 (Patch 4): Fixed couriers incorrectly offering the same delivery immediately after completing it.
}}
